generated.description: A large floating sky-carrier airship built mostly from oak planks, white wool, and iron blocks, with a flat hull, stacked decks, and a stern section that rises into a tall fin. It measures about 117 blocks wide, 65 high, and 285 long, making it a very big build with over 120,000 blocks. Interior details include chests, a furnace, an enchanting table, a cauldron, bookshelves, and red beds, plus many signs and torches.
